<small>Share of each publication type in the field, as estimated by the DFG Head Office for its
review boards (survey of August 2018): 5 = very high (&gt;90 %), 4 = high (75–90 %),
3 = medium (25–75 %), 2 = low (5–25 %), 1 = minimal (&lt;5 %). These are shares, not evaluation
weights; they are a starting point for the weights to be agreed by experts.
Source: Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (2022), ''Academic Publishing as a Foundation and Area of
Leverage for Research Assessment'', position paper, Appendix, Figure 3, p. 74
([https://www.dfg.de/resource/blob/175776/positionspapier-publikationswesen-en.pdf PDF]).
The assignment of DFG review boards to OpenAlex subfields is our own approximation; see
[[DFG publication type survey (2018)]].</small></includeonly>
